location.primary_market: Arizona (Tucson, Phoenix, Mesa, Scottsdale, Chandler, Gilbert, Tempe, Flagstaff)
secondary_markets: US Southwest (New Mexico, Nevada, Southern California, Utah, Colorado)
location.geo_strategy: Lead with Arizona/Tucson local angle, then expand to US-wide. Local trust sells refurbished — people want to buy from someone nearby, not a faceless warehouse.

niche: Refurbished phones, tablets, smartwatches + accessories (cases, chargers, cables, bundles)

target_audience.primary: Budget-conscious tech buyers aged 18-45 in Arizona and US who want quality devices without paying full price
target_audience.secondary: Eco-conscious consumers who prefer refurbished over new for sustainability
target_audience.local_angle: Arizona-based business — University of Arizona students, Tucson families, Phoenix metro commuters, snowbirds needing affordable devices
pain_points: Worried about quality of used/refurbished devices
Don't know which accessories are compatible
Fear of buying a lemon with no warranty
No local refurbished phone shops they can trust in Arizona
desires: Confidence that the device works perfectly
Buying from a real Arizona business, not some random warehouse

brand_voice.tone: Confident, knowledgeable, no-BS. Like a tech-savvy friend who knows the deals.
brand_voice.avoid: Corporate speak, overly formal language, AI-sounding copy
brand_voice.use: Specific numbers, real customer language, direct CTAs

products.usp: Certified refurbished with warranty, graded A/B/C, bundle deals save 20-30%
